title: Picasso and Roland Penrose in Mougins, France

events.n: the selection this print belongs to was curated for the first major posthumous exhibition of Miller's work
events.q: This print is part of a limited-edition selection of 19 of Lee Miller’s images and 1 image by Roland Penrose of Picasso, which spans from the 1930s through to the 1960s and was curated for the first major posthumous exhibition of Miller’s work at the Photographers Gallery in 1984.
